name: tirth-yatra-app
description: Complete Tirth Yatra Pilgrimage Management Application

scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build:local: npm run build:local:backend && npm run build:local:frontend
scripts.build:prod: npm run build:prod:backend && npm run build:prod:frontend
scripts.start:local:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build:local && npx serve -s build -l 3000
scripts.start:prod:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build:prod && npx serve -s build -l 3000

author: Tirth Yatra Team
